title: Hearty Fluffy French Feta Eclair
description: A peppery and fluffy French dish featuring cubed feta cheese, perfect for a date night, served on a talavera plate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, melted butter, and whole milk.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Gently fold in the cubed feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Spoon the mixture into a piping bag fitted with a large round tip.
Pipe the mixture onto a talavera plate in long, thin strips, shaping into eclair forms.
Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the eclairs from the oven and let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the shio-koji over the top of the eclairs and serve immediately.
